title: Chromatic Kiln
pages: Craft the Chromatic Kiln with terracotta, glass, a furnace and two Chromatic Essence from the Verdant Distiller. Its Prismatic Glaze unlocks the Prismatic Press before the Electrolyzer.

Place a furnace below the controller, glass above, terracotta north and south, and lava source blocks east and west, then stack a two-brick flue on top of the glass. All eight parts must remain present. Right-click with a full batch to load the kiln; glazing takes 40 ticks, then collect it with an empty hand. A busy kiln refuses another batch without consuming it; missing or swapped parts pause production.

Sixteen vanilla dyes glaze into their matching stained glass blocks, and each of those stained glass blocks glazes again into its matching stained glass pane, completing a two-stage color pipeline from the Verdant Distiller's pigments. A final recipe condenses two Chromatic Essence into Prismatic Glaze for a later t5 gate.

For automation, insert valid glazing stock into the controller from any face except the bottom and extract products from the bottom; reach these covered faces through Stock Hatches. Each formed batch takes 40 ticks; a missing crown, flue, terracotta wall, lava channel or furnace pauses processing without consuming stock. The controller buffers one input stack and one output stack, saves both and its face modes, and exposes Forge item handlers to hoppers or pipes; stock with no glazing recipe is refused. Sneak-right-click with an empty hand to cycle the clicked face through input, output and disabled; right-click with an empty hand to collect buffered output. It has no FE or fluid port. JEI shows loaded Chromatic Glazing batches and structure requirements under the controller catalyst. Datapacks can add recipes; matching ties resolve by resource ID.

Stock Hatches: every face of this controller is covered by a frame part, so hoppers and pipes reach it through Stock Hatches. Place a hatch instead of any part that touches the controller face-to-face; at most two hatches may stand in, and a third breaks formation. A hatch relays only while the frame is formed, and it relays the controller face it covers: insert stock into a hatch on an In face, and extract products from a hatch whose face you sneak-use with an empty hand to cycle to Out (the base face starts as Out). For example, swap one side part for a hatch fed by a hopper pointing into it from beside, and swap the base part for a hatch with a hopper beneath it. A hopper touching a redstone block or other powered part is locked by vanilla rules. Right-clicking a hatch with an empty hand collects the product buffer.
